title: Campaigns Assistant
description:
About No Limit Email

No Limit Email is a retention marketing agency helping US-based direct-to-consumer and ecommerce brands unlock the full revenue potential of their existing customer base. We've helped over 200 brands generate more than $80 million in email-attributed revenue, working with names like Unilever, Carnivore Snax, Depology, Raycon, and 120+ other ecommerce brands. Our team of 15–20 professionals spans the globe.

The Role

As Campaigns Assistant, you keep production moving. You're the person who makes sure every ClickUp task is assigned, on track, and progressing — and the go-to point of contact for approvals and status updates between clients and the internal team.

This is not a strategy or technical role. Every strategy and Klaviyo-related decision is owned by the Strategist and specialists — your job is to own the process: tasks move, communication flows, approvals get chased down, and nothing falls through the cracks.

You will not be required to attend face-to-face client meetings, but you will be communicating with clients regularly for approvals, feedback, and ad hoc requests.

Responsibilities

  • Move ClickUp tasks through the workflow, assigning team members based on availability and project needs
  • Keep ClickUp accurate at all times: task statuses, due dates, and assignments
  • Manage day-to-day communication with clients — collect approvals, relay feedback, and handle ad hoc requests
  • Route any strategy or technical questions to the Strategist or relevant specialist — the Campaigns Assistant is not expected to answer these
  • Check that client feedback and comments have been actioned by the team before work moves forward
  • Update the project roadmap and status updates so everyone has visibility on where each account stands
  • Maintain organized documentation: briefs, timelines, and approval trails
  • Flag delays or risks on an account to the Strategist as soon as they come up

What Success Looks Like

The best person in this role doesn't wait to be asked. They check, they flag, they follow up, and they close the loop. You keep a close eye on every account you own so nothing sits untouched, and you make sure the right people always have what they need to keep moving.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Agency experience preferred — you understand how client accounts and internal teams operate together
  • Proficiency in ClickUp (or a similar project management tool) and Google Workspace required
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts at once without losing track of details
  • Excellent written communication and sharp attention to detail
  • Self-directed — you notice what needs doing and do it without being asked
  • Ability to work US time zone hours from a remote location

Sobre a Arauco

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

O trabalho também envolverá decisões sobre arquitetura, mensageria, cloud, observabilidade e integração de LLMs, sempre considerando qualidade técnica, capacidade do time, custo de infraestrutura e viabilidade das entregas.

Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de sistemas distribuídos e microsserviços.

  • Trabalhar com Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud e observabilidade.

O que buscamos

  • 8+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • 3+ anos de experiência em arquitetura e/ou liderança técnica.
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js, TypeScript e NestJS.

  • Experiência com GCP ou AWS, Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD.
  • Boa compreensão de SDD, contract-first ou API-first.
  • Experiência prática integrando LLMs em produtos reais, incluindo RAG, agentes, avaliação de outputs, guardrails e controle de custo por token.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, métricas, tracing e logs estruturados.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente, orientar desenvolvedores e negociar prioridades com o negócio.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado, para leitura, documentação e interação em um ambiente internacional.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência com Solace ou BAPI.
  • Conhecimento de gRPC.
  • Experiência com Terraform, Pulumi ou outras ferramentas de Infrastructure as Code.
  • Vivência em consultoria ou em projetos com múltiplos clientes.
  • Experiência com produtos financeiros, fiscais ou outros domínios regulados.

O que oferecemos

title: Senior Marketing Scientist
description:
About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world's biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we've been a leader in consumer insights, and today we're at the center of our industry's biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.

Brands come to us because we've solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we've been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.

Introduction:

We are seeking a senior marketing scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this highly autonomous role, you'll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with research, sales, and client stakeholders to translate business objectives into clear analytical approaches, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Lead end-to-end scoping within approved project scope, including framing business questions, defining hypotheses, and recommending appropriate methodologies, escalating scope changes, commercial commitments, and pricing to AA/DS leadership.
  • Act as a key analytics partner in Brazil, supporting commercial and research leads in client engagements, effectively collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and building strong
  • Provide consultative guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from early-stage solutioning through final delivery and interpretation.
  • Serve as a lead analytics practitioner, independently designing and executing advanced quantitative methodologies, including segmentation, brand tracking, pricing and elasticity modeling, conjoint and MaxDiff, ad and concept testing, claims substantiation, driver analysis, media mix modeling, and attribution.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of analytical projects, ensuring methodological rigor, reproducible code/workflows, documented QC, quality, and business relevance.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights, with strong storytelling tailored to senior stakeholders by clearly explaining the mechanics behind models and analytical approaches, ensuring transparency and stakeholder confidence in results.
  • Design and develop AI-enabled analytics solutions (e.g., analytical agents, automated insight generation, decision support tools) leveraging LLMs or similar technologies, using approved tools within Toluna governance standards and validating all outputs.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can enhance productivity and insight quality across data preparation, modeling, validation, and reporting.
  • Partner with engineering, product, and analytics teams to help operationalize solutions at scale by contributing analytical requirements, validation input, and feedback on repeatable tools and workflows, supporting repeatability and efficiency.
  • Champion automation and standardization, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across engagements.
  • Support the development and adoption of AI governance practices, including responsible use guidelines, bias detection and mitigation, guardrails and evaluation approaches, and documentation standards, escalating privacy, compliance, and governance questions to the appropriate owner.
  • Ensure all analytical and AI-driven outputs maintain high standards of quality, transparency, and ethical integrity.
  • Balance innovation with rigor, ensuring new approaches are credible, defensible, and client ready.
  • Contribute reusable improvements—documented method notes, templates, code components, automations, or QC enhancements—and share them for adoption across AA/DS and other Toluna teams.

Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, marketing science, or market research roles — including conjoint, MaxDiff, segmentation, driver analysis, pricing, and statistical/AI modeling — ideally in a client-facing or consulting environment.
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects end-to-end, from scoping and problem framing through delivery, including stakeholder management and quality control.
  • Demonstrated ability to work closely with non-technical stakeholders (e.g., research, sales, clients), translating business needs into analytical solutions.
  • Fluency in Portuguese & English is required.

**Please submit your CV in English

Our Values:

Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caring

What we offer:

At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 79 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.

Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher, and language class subsidy.

Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Especialista em Segurança da Informação - F5
description:
Somos o Grupo NTSEC, um dos maiores integradores de soluções de cibersegurança do Brasil, unindo NTSec, InfoSec, Zivasec e CloudSec. Com presença nacional, somos mais de 400 profissionais, escritórios em diversas capitais e expansões em andamento!

Há mais de 18 anos, protegemos redes, infraestruturas e dados com segurança, estabilidade e alto desempenho. E somos 4 vezes Great Place to WorkTM!

Buscamos um Especialista em Segurança da Informação com foco em Implantação F5 para liderar projetos de soluções do fabricante, projetar arquiteturas de rede seguras (LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Cloud) e atuar em ambientes corporativos, data centers e híbridos (on-premises e cloud). Você será referência técnica em administração e suporte de ambientes F5 (LTM, ASM, APM), atuando em troubleshooting avançado, análise de performance e melhorias contínuas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de implantação de soluções do fabricante F5;
  • Projetar arquiteturas de rede seguras (LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Cloud);
  • Administrar e suportar ambientes com F5 (LTM, ASM, APM);
  • Atuar em troubleshooting avançado e análise de performance;
  • Planejar e executar upgrades, patches e melhorias contínuas;
  • Apoiar times de infraestrutura, redes e segurança;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e relatórios.

Para participar desta seleção, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Redes ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com F5 BIG-IP (LTM, ASM, APM);
  • Vivência em troubleshooting em ambientes críticos;
  • Experiência em planejamento, implementação e governança de projetos de redes seguras;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte;
  • Conhecimentos Avançado em redes (TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, DNS);
  • Atuação em Segurança de aplicações (WAF, OWASP Top 10);
  • Vivência com Ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • Experiência com automação (Ansible, Python, iControl REST API);
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e CI/CD;
  • Certificações desejáveis: F5-CA, F5-CTS, F5-CSE, CompTIA Security+ e/ou CompTIA Network+.

Nossos benefícios:

Saúde e Bem-Estar

  • Plano de saúde e plano odontológico
  • Acesso ao Total Pass e Parceria WellHub
  • Parceria Zinn Clínica: atendimento de telemedicina para cuidar da sua saúde com praticidade

Alimentação e Mobilidade

  • Cartão Food aceito em restaurantes e supermercados
  • Vale-transporte ou Auxílio Mobilidade - você escolhe o que faz mais sentido para sua rotina

Crescimento e Reconhecimento

  • Treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Reembolso em certificações (conforme política interna)
  • Programa de Idiomas para ampliar suas habilidades (conforme política interna)
  • Treinamentos pagos + viagens nacionais e internacionais
  • Bônus Anual para reconhecer sua contribuição (conforme política interna)
  • Convênios com instituições de ensino de Graduação e Pós-graduação: Uniceub, Universidade Católica de Brasília, UNIFOR e IPOG
  • Bônus Indicação: indique talentos e seja recompensado

Qualidade de Vida, Lazer e Família

  • Parceria On Happy: descontos exclusivos em viagens e lazer para você e sua família
  • Day off no aniversário - porque seu dia é especial!
  • Kit maternidade e paternidade para celebrar esse momento tão importante

Se você busca um lugar que valoriza o seu desenvolvimento e o seu bem-estar, essa vaga pode ser o próximo passo da sua carreira. Candidate-se e venha crescer com a gente!

title: Especialista de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A) - Foco em Covenants Financeiros
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Objetivo da Posição

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A), fechamento gerencial e gestão de indicadores financeiros, com forte atuação no acompanhamento e controle de covenants financeiros, endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem. Este (a) profissional será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade das informações financeiras, suportar a tomada de decisão da liderança e assegurar a aderência às obrigações financeiras e contratuais da companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o fechamento gerencial das concessões e holdings do grupo, assegurando a qualidade e consistência das informações financeiras.
  • Monitorar e controlar os covenants financeiros previstos em contratos de dívida, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e antecipando potenciais riscos de descumprimento.
  • Acompanhar indicadores financeiros relacionados ao endividamento e à alavancagem, incluindo Dívida Líquida, EBITDA, Dívida Líquida/EBITDA e cobertura de juros.
  • Elaborar análises de realizado versus orçamento e forecast, identificando desvios, causas e impactos no desempenho financeiro.
  • Consolidar informações financeiras de diferentes empresas e estruturas societárias do grupo.
  • Participar da elaboração, atualização e acompanhamento de forecasts mensais, projeções financeiras e análises de cenários.
  • Atuar no controle e acompanhamento de contratos de financiamento e demais instrumentos de dívida corporativa.
  • Desenvolver materiais gerenciais e apresentações executivas para reporte à alta liderança e suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar a validação de informações contábeis e financeiras relacionadas aos indicadores monitorados.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros, controles internos e modelos de análise.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A), fechamento gerencial e consolidação financeira.
  • Vivência comprovada com controle e monitoramento de covenants financeiros, endividamento corporativo e indicadores de alavancagem.
  • Conhecimento em análise de demonstrativos financeiros, fluxo de caixa, projeções financeiras e construção de cenários.
  • Experiência na elaboração de análises de realizado versus orçamento e forecast.
  • Conhecimento em contratos de dívida, financiamentos e estrutura de capital.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • Power BI (desejável).
  • Power Query (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) ou ferramentas similares (desejável).

Formação

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins será considerado um diferencial.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

title: Analista Comercial (Inside Sales) | Mesa de Produtos
description:
Sobre a Quark

Somos uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Em poucos anos, passamos de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, com cerca de 70 assessores e mais de 3.000 clientes. Fomos eleitos Revelação Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores escritórios da rede.

Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma vaga para quem tem perfil comercial e quer construir carreira no mercado financeiro. Você vai ser a ponte entre os nossos assessores e as áreas de produto da Quark: entende a fundo os produtos — renda fixa, renda variável, seguros, consórcios — e ajuda os assessores a levá-los aos clientes deles.

É preciso ter tino comercial, vontade de aprender e energia para fazer negócios acontecerem. No caminho, você conta com apoio para se certificar e crescer.

O que você vai fazer

  • Entender os produtos: dominar renda fixa, renda variável, seguros e consórcios para virar a referência de produto dos assessores.
  • Gerar oportunidades: trabalhar junto com os assessores, olhando as carteiras deles em busca de demandas de produto.
  • Apoiar a venda: apresentar as soluções de forma clara e conduzir cada oportunidade até o fechamento, com apoio no começo.
  • Cuidar do pipeline: controlar o funil no CRM, acompanhando cada oportunidade até a conversão.
  • Manter proximidade: conduzir os follow-ups e manter um canal aberto e constante com a rede de assessores.

O que buscamos em você

  • Perfil comercial: experiência com vendas, atendimento ou relacionamento com clientes — em qualquer setor, não precisa ser no mercado financeiro.
  • Vontade de aprender: interesse real pelo mercado financeiro e disposição para estudar os produtos e se certificar.
  • Comunicação clara e boa escuta.
  • Energia e disciplina para conduzir o pipeline e buscar resultado.
  • Formação: ensino superior completo ou em andamento.

O que oferecemos

  • Apoio para obter a certificação ANCORD.
  • Uma trilha para aprender os produtos e o funcionamento da mesa, com acompanhamento próximo.
  • Muito espaço para crescer conforme a sua evolução e os seus resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas de produtos ou serviços.
  • Boa desenvoltura com CRM.
  • Conhecimento inicial de produtos financeiros.

Se você tem energia para vender e aprender rápido, candidate-se por aqui. Vamos gostar de te conhecer.

title: Mainframe Lead - Remote
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role Purpose:

Lead the design, development and delivery of mainframe solutions, owning technical quality for the team: translating requirements into robust designs, guiding engineers day to day, and ensuring predictable, secure and maintainable delivery into production.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Design & Delivery
  • Own detailed design for mainframe components, interfaces and enhancements within the agreed architecture.
  • Break down requirements into technical tasks, estimates, sequencing and clear acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver hands-on development for complex or high-risk components alongside the team.
  • Ensure designs meet performance, security, reliability and maintainability expectations.
  • Team Leadership
  • Guide a team of developers on design decisions, coding standards and technical approach.
  • Run code reviews, design walkthroughs, defect triage and technical knowledge sharing.
  • Mentor engineers, support onboarding and build depth across the mainframe skill set.
  • Quality & Operations
  • Define and enforce unit, integration and regression testing expectations for the team.
  • Own build, release and deployment readiness including rollback and verification steps.
  • Drive defect prevention, root-cause analysis and permanent fixes over workarounds.
  • Collaboration & Governance
  • Work with architects, business analysts, QA, DevOps and support teams across the delivery lifecycle.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies, planning, estimation and dependency management.
  • Maintain technical documentation, standards and reusable assets for the team.

Technology Focus — Mainframe

  • Design, develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 batch and online components within agreed standards.
  • Optimize batch windows, DB2 access paths and resource consumption to protect service levels.
  • Support mainframe modernization, API exposure and integration with distributed and cloud platforms.

Required Technical Competencies:

  • COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2 and z/OS utilities; batch and online program design and optimization.
  • Design & Architecture Mainframe application architecture, modularization, API enablement and modernization/coexistence patterns.
  • Data & Integration DB2 and VSAM data design, SQL tuning, file handling, data conversion, integrity and reconciliation.
  • Platform & DevOps z/OS operations, scheduling, change management, environment promotion and mainframe-to-distributed integration.
  • Quality & Operations Unit and regression testing, batch cycle validation, performance and MIPS optimization, defect RCA.

Leadership & Behavioural:

  • Ownership and accountability for team technical outcomes.
  • Practical problem solving with a bias for clean, sustainable solutions.
  • Clear communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Coaching mindset and collaborative working style.
  • Participate in on-site and virtual workshops, design reviews and governance forums.
  • Effective communication in a multi-country model, with overlap into European and Indian working hours.

Key Deliverables & Success Measures:

  • Detailed designs, estimates and technical plans agreed with architecture and delivery leads.
  • High-quality, reviewed and tested code delivered to agreed timelines.
  • Stable releases with low defect leakage and effective production handover.
  • Improved team capability,

title: Especialista de Manutenção (Goiânia/GO)
description:

Juntos temos futuro!

title: Business Development & 360 Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a high-performance, sales-driven professional to build and scale our Renewable Energy business in Brazil.

This role reports directly to the BD Director in Brazil and works closely with local business leadership and global business development team. This role offers a unique opportunity to build, scale, and lead our Renewable Energy practice in Brazil, with full commercial ownership and direct impact on business growth

This is a full-cycle, business-critical role where you will be responsible not only for delivering top talent but also for developing new business and expanding existing accounts in Brazil. You will operate across sales, recruitment, and day-to-day operations, owning the full lifecycle - from prospecting and closing deals to executing recruitment processes and managing client relationships and contracts.

This is a role for someone who thrives in a high-performance, target-driven environment, with strong ownership and commercial ambition.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Market Expansion

  • Proactively develop new business opportunities in Brazil, expanding existing service lines and driving revenue growth
  • Identify market opportunities, assess feasibility, and recommend new business initiatives
  • Actively prospect new clients through cold outreach, networking, and market intelligence
  • Lead commercial discussions, present solutions, and close new deals
  • Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and client presentations
  • Conduct regular client visits (prospects and existing clients) to strengthen relationships and generate new opportunities
  • Support and coordinate strategic initiatives such as partnerships, mergers, or business associations

Client Management & Account Growth

  • Build strong relationships with client leadership and key stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to expand, improve, or troubleshoot existing services and contracts
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and promote a strong market image of the company
  • Perform regular client follow-ups to ensure smooth contract execution and service delivery
  • Critically review new contracts, renewals, and amendments

Recruitment & Operational Delivery (Hands-on)

  • Run end-to-end recruitment processes (job briefing, sourcing, interviews, offer negotiation)
  • Actively source candidates using multiple channels (LinkedIn, direct search, referrals, etc.)
  • Work closely with internal teams to initiate recruitment processes based on client demands
  • Stay deeply involved in the day-to-day recruitment operations, ensuring speed and quality
  • Manage multiple open roles simultaneously while maintaining a high delivery standard

Commercial & Operational Management

  • Manage and oversee contracts and proposals within the Brazilian operation
  • Collaborate with the Business Managers to prepare and execute budgets
  • Ensure alignment between sales, recruitment delivery, and financial targets
  • Drive accountability for both revenue generation and operational excellence
  • Fluent English (mandatory - daily interaction with international clients and candidates)
  • Strong background in sales, business development, or client acquisition
  • Demonstrated ability to generate leads and close new business
  • Highly resilient, proactive, and target-oriented mindset True hunter profile - comfortable with cold outreach and rejection
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Ability to balance sales + delivery execution without compromising either
  • High energy, competitiveness, and ambition to outperform targets
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the renewable energy sector (solar, wind, etc.)
  • Proven experience in recruitment (agency or in-house)
  • Previous experience in a 360 recruitment role
  • Existing client network or market specialization

What We Offer

  • You will lead the growth of our Renewable Energy vertical in Brazil, with full ownership of market development.
  • High visibility within both local and global leadership teams.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • Professional development
  • International exposure
  • Fast-track career progression based on performance

title: Pré-Vendas (SDR)
description:
Pré-Vendas (SDR)

  • Carga horária / Escala: Horário comercial (Segunda a Sexta, das 8h às 18h18).

title: Production Supervisor
description:
The Resource: Production Engine Assembly, Vehicle assembly, Fabrication, Paint shop and machining is responsible for achieving the production targets of vehicles (as per model mix) in adherence to quality, safety and cost standards. The incumbent will work to deliver production targets of the vehicle to the Outbound Logistics team as per PPC plan.

1. Production Execution

  • Supervise and control day-to-day production activities within the assigned production area/line to achieve planned volume, quality, productivity and delivery targets.
  • Execute the production plan in coordination with PPC and the Production Manager.
  • Allocate manpower, workstations and resources to achieve shift-wise production requirements.
  • Monitor line performance, cycle time, line balance and production output throughout the shift.
  • Ensure adherence to approved standard operating procedures, work instructions, process parameters and production standards.

2. Safety & Shop-Floor Discipline

  • Ensure a safe, clean and disciplined working environment across the assigned production area.
  • Enforce compliance with applicable safety procedures, PPE requirements, statutory requirements and standard operating practices.
  • Identify unsafe conditions and behaviours and initiate immediate corrective actions.
  • Conduct and participate in daily safety briefings, toolbox talks and safety observations.
  • Escalate serious safety risks and incidents to the Production Manager and relevant Safety/HR functions.

3. Quality Control

  • Ensure production is carried out in accordance with quality standards, control plans, SOPs and inspection requirements.
  • Monitor process quality and respond immediately to defects, abnormalities and customer-critical issues.
  • Coordinate with Quality to contain non-conforming products and prevent recurrence.
  • Ensure proper segregation and control of rejected, reworked and suspect material.
  • Support root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

4. Equipment & Maintenance Coordination

  • Monitor equipment and line availability and minimize production losses caused by breakdowns, minor stoppages and equipment abnormalities.
  • Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Support maintenance planning by providing production requirements and equipment availability information.
  • Follow up on breakdown recovery and ensure equipment is safely released back to production.
  • Monitor equipment-related losses and contribute to improving OEE.

5. Production Performance & OEE

  • Review shift-wise production performance against plan and identify gaps in volume, cycle time, downtime, OEE and productivity.
  • Analyse production losses and implement immediate corrective actions within the supervisor's authority.
  • Escalate unresolved production constraints to the Production Manager with a clear recovery plan.
  • Maintain accurate production records and ensure timely reporting of shift performance.

6. Manpower & Team Leadership

  • Deploy and manage operators according to production requirements, skills and workstation needs.
  • Monitor attendance, manpower availability, operator utilization and overtime requirements.
  • Develop operator capability through on-the-job training, skill certification and cross-training.
  • Build self-directed operating teams and promote ownership of Safety, Quality, Delivery and Productivity.
  • Conduct regular team communication and performance reviews.

7. Productivity & Cost Control

  • Identify and reduce production losses arising from downtime, rejection, rework, material wastage, inefficient manpower utilization and process losses.
  • Implement approved productivity and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Monitor key production losses and take corrective action to achieve agreed targets.
  • Support line balancing, cycle-time improvement and workstation optimization.

8. Continuous Improvement

  • Lead and participate in shop-floor improvement activities using Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, TPM, TQM and other structured improvement methodologies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality, safety, OEE, ergonomics and process efficiency.
  • Support implementation of approved improvement projects within agreed timelines.
  • Standardize successful improvements and ensure sustained implementation.

9. New Product / Engineering Change Support

  • Support new model introduction, process changes and engineering changes at the shop-floor level.
  • Ensure operators are trained and work instructions are updated before implementation of new or revised processes.
  • Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality and Production Management during trial production and production ramp-up.
  • Ensure production changes are implemented only against approved documentation.

10. Daily Management & Escalation

  • Conduct shift start-up and daily production meetings to review targets, manpower, material availability, equipment status, quality issues and safety concerns.
  • Maintain effective communication with PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Manufacturing Engineering and other support functions.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly to the Production Manager.
  • Ensure timely closure of assigned corrective actions.

In order to be successful for this role you will have experience within the Automotive Industry preferably Motorcycle manufacturing sector.

and possess 5+ years' experience in a similar role.

Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India's mid-sized two-wheeler segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a vehicle for exploration and self-expression. It's an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield's premium line-up includes the all-new Meteor 350 cruiser, Interceptor 650 and Continental GT 650 twins, the Himalayan adventure tourer, and the iconic Bullet 350 and Classic 350 singles. Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Rider Mania, an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa and Himalayan Odyssey, a yearly pilgrimage over some of the toughest terrain and highest mountain passes.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through 921 large format dealerships and 638 studio stores in all major cities and towns in India and exports to over 60 countries around the globe. The company's two state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal, near Chennai. Royal Enfield recently invested in two world-class technical centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and Chennai, India, and in 2020 opened its first assembly unit outside India, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. With more than 17% growth year-on-year for the last 5 years and sales in international markets up 96% in , Royal Enfield is the leader in the global mid-size motorcycle market.

title: Right Hand to the Managing Director: Client Ops, Onboarding & Admin at an AI-Driven Investment Firm (Remote)
description:
Company: SkySail Strategies | Applied Quantitative Research and Investments Location: Remote. We are hiring in Brazil and Lebanon. Candidates elsewhere are welcome to apply if they can work US Eastern hours. Hours: Full time, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern Engagement: Independent contractor, paid monthly in USD Compensation: USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month depending on experience, with a review after 90 days

About SkySail Strategies

SkySail Strategies is a quantitative research and investment firm based in Tampa, Florida. We build proprietary AI-driven market models and run a client program built on them. Our clients are individual investors and partners who connect their own brokerage accounts to our systems, and the experience they have from first contact through their first months with us is the heart of what we deliver.

We are a small, fast-moving firm that runs on AI tools. We use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft, organize, automate, and analyze, and we expect the person in this role to do the same.

The role

You will own client operations and act as the right hand to our Managing Director. In practice that means two things.

First, you make sure every client gets onboarded completely, on time, and without anything falling through the cracks. You guide them through our onboarding process, help them connect their brokerage accounts to our platform, track where each client is in the process, and follow up until every required step is done. Many of our clients invest through self-directed IRAs, which means coordinating between the client, an IRA custodian (Equity Trust), a futures broker (StoneX), and our trading platform (MetaTrader 5). You will become the person who knows that process cold.

Second, you keep the business running smoothly behind the scenes: invoicing, payment tracking, client requests, task management for the Managing Director, and building the processes that let all of this run without constant supervision. Our client operations live in a CRM (GoHighLevel), and you will own it: the pipelines, the automations, the follow-up sequences, and the reporting that tells us where every client stands.

Most of your day is spent communicating: writing to clients, replying in chat, and keeping the Managing Director informed. How you come across in writing and on a call is a large part of how our clients experience the firm, so we care a lot about it.

This is an operations and client service role. It does not involve soliciting investors, giving investment advice, or discussing investment performance. Those conversations are handled by the firm's principals.

What you will do

  • Run our client onboarding process end to end: welcome new clients, walk them through each step, and help them integrate their brokerage account connections with our platform
  • Coordinate with custodians and brokers on the client's behalf, by phone, chat, and email, to get accounts opened, funded, and connected
  • Monitor every client's onboarding status, chase incomplete tasks, and make sure nothing stalls
  • Be the friendly, responsive first point of contact for clients over email and chat, and route anything outside your scope to the right person quickly
  • Keep clients on track with the actions they need to take, with clear reminders and follow-ups
  • Prepare and send invoices, record client payments, reconcile what is owed and what has been paid, and flag anything overdue
  • Organize and track client needs and requests so every item has an owner, a status, and a deadline
  • Manage the Managing Director's task list, calendar, and miscellaneous administrative items
  • Document our processes, spot where they break, and improve them. You will be expected to build checklists, templates, and automations rather than just follow them
  • Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) as a core part of your daily work: drafting client communications, summarizing, organizing, building workflows, and automating repetitive steps

Who we are looking for

  • 3+ years in an executive assistant, operations coordinator, client onboarding, customer success, or administrative management role, ideally supporting a founder or executive directly
  • You have run client or sales operations out of a CRM (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar) and you have built or modified pipelines, automations, and follow-up sequences in it, not just entered data. We will ask you to walk us through one you built.
  • Strong, daily working familiarity with AI LLM tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar), or a demonstrated ability to pick up new tools fast and put them to work. We will ask you to show us.
  • High agency and high proactivity. You see what needs doing and do it. You ask forgiveness, not permission, on small things, and you raise big things early.
  • Exceptional organization and executive functioning: you keep many threads moving at once and nothing gets dropped
  • Excellent communication skills. Your written English is clear, correct, and natural, and you are confident and articulate on the phone and on video. You will be writing to clients every day and speaking with them regularly.
  • Strong people skills. You are warm, patient, and professional with clients, including ones who are anxious, frustrated, or not technical. You read people well, you know when to reassure and when to escalate, and clients come away from every interaction feeling taken care of.
  • Fast, accurate typing: at least 55 words per minute. This is a chat-heavy role and we will verify it (see How to apply).
  • Comfortable with numbers and with keeping accurate financial records
  • Reliable home office setup: fast internet, backup connectivity, and a quiet space for calls

Nice to have

  • Background in financial services, investing, or brokerage account operations (account opening, account linking, KYC, funding, IRA custodians)
  • GoHighLevel specifically
  • Experience building automations outside the CRM (Zapier, Make, or AI-based)
  • Experience working remotely for a US company

What we offer

  • A stable, long-term, full-time engagement with a growing firm
  • Direct work with the Managing Director and real ownership of your area
  • Freedom to build and improve processes rather than just execute them
  • A 90-day review with a compensation adjustment for strong performance

How to apply - APPLY HERE:

Send us three things:

Your resume. (So we have it in one place)

A short video (under 3 minutes) using Loom or any screen or webcam recorder. Title it exactly: Your Name, SkySail, Admin Manager. One take is fine; please don't over-produce it. Answer two questions:

  • What made you interested in this role specifically?
  • Why do you think you would be great at it?

A screenshot of a one-minute typing test from typing.com or 10fastfingers.com showing your words per minute and accuracy. We are looking for 55+ WPM at 95%+ accuracy.

title: Gerente De Manutencao Sr.
description:
About the role

O Maintenance Senior Manager será responsável por liderar a estratégia de manutenção da planta, garantindo alta confiabilidade dos ativos, segurança operacional, produtividade, qualidade e controle de custos. Esta posição exige um profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão estratégica e presença constante no chão de fábrica, atuando de forma próxima às operações para assegurar a continuidade dos processos e o desenvolvimento da equipe.

Buscamos um profissional que combine excelência técnica com forte habilidade interpessoal, sendo capaz de influenciar diferentes áreas, promover colaboração e conduzir iniciativas de melhoria contínua em um ambiente industrial de alta complexidade.

A posição possui papel fundamental na evolução da maturidade da manutenção da planta, fortalecendo programas preventivos e preditivos, desenvolvendo líderes e promovendo uma cultura de confiabilidade, segurança e resultados.

Preferência por profissionais residentes no Sul de Minas ou com disponibilidade para mudança definitiva para a região.

Key responsibilities

  • Liderar a estratégia global de manutenção da planta.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade dos ativos e redução de paradas não planejadas.
  • Implementar e fortalecer programas de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e TPM.
  • Gerenciar equipes de manutenção, confiabilidade e planejamento.
  • Liderar aproximadamente 35 a 50 profissionais, entre colaboradores próprios e terceiros.
  • Gerenciar diretamente três Coordenadores de Manutenção, apoiando seu desenvolvimento e amadurecimento profissional.
  • Atuar fortemente no desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe.
  • Conduzir projetos de melhoria contínua, modernização de equipamentos e aumento da confiabilidade operacional.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar indicadores de desempenho como OEE, MTBF, MTTR, produtividade, segurança, qualidade, turnover, absenteísmo e custos de manutenção.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de requisitos legais, normas corporativas, auditorias e certificações.
  • Gerenciar orçamento de manutenção (OPEX e CAPEX), contratos, fornecedores e almoxarifado de manutenção.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para otimização de custos sem comprometer a segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade dos ativos.
  • Atuar em parceria com Produção, Qualidade e EHS para assegurar a eficiência operacional.
  • Manter forte presença no chão de fábrica, participando ativamente da resolução de problemas críticos.
  • Implementar uma cultura orientada à prevenção, planejamento e melhoria contínua.
  • Estruturar e fortalecer os processos da área de manutenção preventiva e confiabilidade.
  • Promover um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance, desenvolvendo relacionamentos sólidos em toda a planta.
  • Influenciar equipes multifuncionais para atingir objetivos operacionais e estratégicos.
  • Garantir que problemas sejam tratados com senso de urgência e não permaneçam sem solução ou acompanhamento.

Qualifications and skills

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • MBA ou Pós-graduação será considerado diferencial.
  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em manutenção industrial.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos em posições de liderança.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes de manutenção industrial.
  • Histórico sólido na implementação de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e programas de TPM.
  • Experiência em gestão de ativos, confiabilidade e melhoria contínua.
  • Vivência com gestão de orçamento, contratos e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de Lean Manufacturing e Continuous Improvement.
  • Experiência na condução de projetos de melhoria de desempenho operacional e redução de custos.
  • Capacidade para atuar estrategicamente sem perder a proximidade com a operação e o chão de fábrica.
  • Forte habilidade de análise de falhas, resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
  • Excelente capacidade de planejamento, organização e definição de prioridades.
  • Perfil colaborativo, com facilidade de relacionamento e influência.
  • Liderança inspiradora com foco no desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Forte orientação para resultados, senso de urgência e espírito de dono.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes de alta pressão e elevada complexidade operacional.
  • Desejável experiência em plantas industriais com grande volume de auditorias e exigências regulatórias.
  • Desejável experiência com secadores industriais e equipamentos de processo.
  • Inglês intermediário desejável.
  • Espanhol intermediário desejável.
  • Certificações como CMRP, CRL, PMP ou Lean Six Sigma serão consideradas diferenciais.

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Especialista de Planejamento e Gestão de Obras

title: Assessor de Investimentos (Farmer) - Jr | Assessoria de Investimentos do Banco Safra
description:
Quark Investimentos

Somos a Quark Investimentos, uma assessoria de investimentos credenciada pelo Banco Safra — a solidez de um banco com mais de 180 anos somada à agilidade de uma assessoria. Fomos eleitos Escritório Revelação do Safra em 2024 e estamos entre os três melhores da rede. Por trás desses prêmios estão mais de R$1 bilhão sob custódia, 70 assessores e uma carteira de mais de 3.000 clientes.

Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma vaga para quem gosta de relacionamento e quer construir carreira como assessor de investimentos. Diferente de uma posição de prospecção, aqui você não caça cliente no frio: você cuida da base de investidores que já é da casa — acompanha de perto, entende os objetivos de cada um e ajuda a fazer o patrimônio render.

Na prática, você é um "farmer": cultiva os relacionamentos, mantém os clientes satisfeitos e identifica, dentro da própria carteira, oportunidades de investir melhor. É uma porta de entrada boa para quem quer aprender o mercado financeiro pelo lado do cliente. No caminho, você conta com apoio para se certificar e evoluir.

O que você vai fazer

  • Acompanhar a base: manter uma agenda ativa de contato com os investidores, revisar carteiras, tirar dúvidas e garantir que fiquem satisfeitos.
  • Reter e fidelizar: perceber quando um cliente está insatisfeito ou pensando em sair (churn) e agir rápido para reverter, sempre gerando valor no atendimento.
  • Trazer novos recursos: identificar potencial não explorado na carteira e trazer para a Quark recursos do investidor que hoje estão em outras instituições.
  • Aproveitar oportunidades de alocação: acompanhar vencimentos e liquidez da carteira para propor reinvestimentos na hora certa, evitando dinheiro parado.
  • Oferecer novos produtos (cross-selling): apresentar soluções do ecossistema Quark — previdência, fundos, operações estruturadas, crédito com garantia de investimentos ou seguros — de acordo com o perfil de cada cliente (suitability).

O que buscamos em você

  • Perfil relacional: você gosta de gente, sabe ouvir e entende o que o cliente precisa.
  • Jeito de farmer: foco em cultivar e crescer relacionamentos de longo prazo, não em vender no impulso.
  • Senso de urgência: agilidade para resolver problemas e não deixar o cliente esperando.
  • Interesse pelo mercado financeiro: vontade de aprender os produtos e de se certificar.
  • Formação: ensino superior completo ou em conclusão (Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou correlatas).

O que oferecemos

  • Apoio para obter as certificações do mercado (ANCORD, CPA-20, CEA).
  • Acompanhamento próximo para você aprender os produtos e a rotina de atendimento.
  • Uma base ativa de clientes para cuidar — você começa com carteira, sem precisar prospectar do zero.
  • Espaço para crescer na carreira de assessor conforme a sua evolução.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente, suporte comercial ou pós-venda em corretoras, bancos ou plataformas de investimento.
  • Certificação ANCORD ativa.
  • Boa desenvoltura com CRM.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.

title: Strategy Operations Sr. Manager
description:
About the Role

As a Strategy & Operations Sr. Manager, you will sit at the intersection of finance, pricing, and commercial strategy — shaping how we win in international markets. Your financial expertise will directly influence our international expansion and revenue growth.

This is a role with real strategic impact: you will own the analytical engine behind our quotation and pricing decisions, translating market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and P&L structures into pricing strategies that balance profitability with market competitiveness. You will work closely with account managers, finance teams, and cross-cultural partners in a fast-growing international environment.

Beyond the analysis, you will build the playbook: developing quotation guidelines, approval workflows, and best practices that scale with the business — while growing deep expertise in international pricing strategy and commercial operations along the way.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & P&L Management

  • Analyze profit and loss structures across markets, products, and service models to understand cost drivers and margin opportunities.
  • Build comprehensive financial models incorporating variable costs, fixed costs, market dynamics, and competitive positioning.
  • Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity testing to evaluate the impact of different pricing strategies on overall profitability.

Quotation Development & Optimization

  • Develop accurate and competitive quotation proposals based on financial analysis, market research, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with account managers to gather client requirements, market conditions, and competitive intelligence for quotation preparation.
  • Continuously optimize quotation templates and processes to improve efficiency and accuracy while maintaining compliance.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Monitor market pricing trends, competitor strategies, and industry dynamics to inform quotation decisions.
  • Analyze historical quotation performance and win/loss rates to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Provide regular market intelligence reports to support strategic pricing decisions.

Process Improvement & Best Practices

  • Develop and maintain quotation guidelines, templates, and approval workflows to ensure consistency and compliance.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline quotation processes and improve turnaround times.
  • Train and support account managers on financial analysis and quotation best practices.

Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in financial analysis, pricing, or commercial operations, preferably in cross-border e-commerce or platform businesses.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, with advanced proficiency in financial analysis tools.
  • Excellent English proficiency (written and verbal) for international communication and documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Collaborative and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, or on-demand platform businesses where pricing strategy is critical for market success.
  • Background in commercial operations, pricing strategy, or financial planning & analysis (FP&A).
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to balance financial objectives with market competitiveness.
  • Experience with data analysis tools for market and performance analysis.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager to support our growing retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Maintaining risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Optimising key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Quantifying risk exposures, considering stakeholder impact where possible
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or that could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • 6+ years of experience in consumer credit risk within financial services, banks, payment institutions, and/or related services
  • Knowledge of key products, like credit cards and unsecured personal loans
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience within the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

Atua de forma integrada com fornecedores, parceiros logísticos e áreas internas, contribuindo para a continuidade das operações e para a disponibilidade dos itens necessários ao negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Acompanhar a consolidação de cargas e apoiar o planejamento logístico conforme os destinos de entrega.
  • Monitorar prazos logísticos, identificando desvios e comunicando os impactos às áreas envolvidas.
  • Atualizar sistemas, controles internos e relatórios com informações de embarques e custos logísticos.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos relacionados à importação e logística internacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência prévia em importação internacional, com atuação em gestão e acompanhamento de embarques.
  • Conhecimento dos fluxos de importação e da documentação utilizada em operações de comércio exterior.
  • Vivência no relacionamento com fornecedores internacionais e parceiros logísticos.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação escrita e verbal com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço.
  • Capacidade de organização, gestão de prioridades e acompanhamento de múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Perfil analítico, atenção aos detalhes e foco no cumprimento de prazos.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento básico em Power BI, Power Query e SQL.
  • Experiência com sistemas de importação e/ou ERP.
  • Domínio de Excel para controles, análises e acompanhamento de indicadores.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados aplicada a operações logísticas e de comércio exterior.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.
